verdict.rationale: Floot's docs say a project is a real TypeScript/React app that you 'can read or export', which partly covers opening the generated code. Nothing in the pack documents editing that code directly inside the builder; export implies editing happens elsewhere. missing for 10: documented in-builder code editor, evidence that edits made in the builder persist and apply to the app, confirmation that code viewing happens inside the builder rather than via export, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open and edit the generated source code directly inside the builder

citations.quote: A Floot project is a real TypeScript and React app — pages, components, and backend endpoints — and you can read or export all of it.
